visual_direction.intended_experience: A practical workbench for finding and judging ideas, experimental without feeling provisional or opaque.
visual_direction.brand_posture: Existing ChannelSmith theme; content and evidence provide the character, with no new decorative chrome.
evaluation_criteria: the reason for every result is legible

responsive_rules: candidate media and body stack below 720px
actions stay reachable without horizontal scroll
accessibility_requirements: feedback state conveyed in text and aria-pressed
images have concise contextual alt text
preserved_behavior: app remains usable when Qdrant is down

form_contracts: GET exploration form: channel then distance
POST feedback action: target, video, distance, decision, rank
brand_and_content: ChannelSmith theme and plain evidence language
accessibility_behavior: native controls, semantic forms, focus-visible treatment, non-color feedback state

validation_targets: focused Jest ranker and payload tests
